g.text: ● debugging at 1.97368 MHz — green marks the next op, red a breakpoint
program: everything except + - < > [ ] , . is a comment. Run appends '!'. End input makes the next ',' read 0. Stop ends the run.
nput for ',', sent raw on enter
# dbg ready: n=step c=continue q=quit b<n>=breakpoint
# dbg pc=0 op=+ vptr=0 data=00 bstk=00 exec=0
